title: SBI Retail Domestic Term Deposit Rates
approvedBy: State Bank of India public website
content: SBI public reference for retail domestic term deposits below INR 3 crore, last updated 2026-05-01. Revised rates effective 2025-12-15: 7 days to 45 days public 3.05% and senior citizen 3.55%; 46 days to 179 days public 4.90% and senior citizen 5.40%; 180 days to 210 days public 5.65% and senior citizen 6.15%; 211 days to less than 1 year public 5.90% and senior citizen 6.40%; 1 year to less than 2 years public 6.25% and senior citizen 6.75%; 2 years to less than 3 years public 6.40% and senior citizen 6.90%; 3 years to less than 5 years public 6.30% and senior citizen 6.80%; 5 years and up to 10 years public 6.05% and senior citizen 7.05%, including the SBI We-care 50 bps additional premium where applicable. Non-callable retail term deposits from INR 1.01 crore to less than INR 3 crore show 1 year at public 6.55% senior 7.05% and 2 years at public 6.80% senior 7.30%. Amrit Vrishti 444 days is 6.45% from 2025-12-15. SBI Patrons gives super senior citizens aged 80 years and above 10 bps over the senior citizen rate, excluding recurring deposits, green rupee term deposits, tax savings scheme 2006, MODS, Capgain, and non-callable term deposits. SBI Green Rupee Term Deposit tenors 1111, 1777, and 2222 days are at par with card rate from 2026-05-01. Staff must verify live CBS/card rates before booking.

title: SBI Debit Card Charges
approvedBy: State Bank of India public website
content: SBI public debit-card charge reference, last updated 2026-03-13. Debit card issuance is NIL for Classic, Silver, Global, and Contactless cards; Gold issuance is INR 100 plus GST; My Card International is INR 250 plus GST; Platinum is INR 300 plus GST; HPCL Co-Branded Everyday card is INR 350 plus GST; Mastercard World is INR 800 plus GST; Pragati Platinum is INR 399 plus GST; Nari Shakti Platinum is INR 499 plus GST; SBI One Touch is INR 399 plus GST. Annual maintenance from the second year: Classic, Silver, and Global Contactless INR 200 plus GST; Yuva, Gold, Combo, and My Card INR 250 plus GST; Platinum INR 325 plus GST; Platinum Business RuPay INR 350 plus GST; Pride/Premium Business INR 425 plus GST. Replacement charges: Nari Shakti Platinum INR 499 plus GST, Pragati Platinum INR 399 plus GST, all other debit cards INR 300 plus GST. International charges include ATM balance enquiry INR 25 plus GST, ATM cash withdrawal minimum INR 100 plus 3.5% of transaction amount plus GST, and PoS/e-commerce 3% of transaction amount plus GST.

title: SBI Savings Account Through Video KYC
approvedBy: State Bank of India public website
content: SBI public reference for opening a savings account through Video KYC on YONO. Customer can open a savings account 24x7 without visiting a branch. Features include paperless opening, Aadhaar details and physical PAN required, NEFT/IMPS/UPI access through YONO or Online SBI, RuPay Classic card issuance, internet/mobile banking access, SMS alerts, SBI Quick missed-call facility, account transfer facility through internet banking, mandatory nomination, signature capture during Video KYC, passbook if requested, and charges for other services as applicable to regular savings accounts. Eligibility: resident Indians above 18 years who are literate, new to bank with no active SBI CIF or relationship, single mode of operation only. Requirements: original physical PAN and Aadhaar number, Aadhaar must carry current address, Aadhaar-registered mobile must be available for OTP, mobile number is mandatory, and customer must be physically present in India during the process. Opening steps: download YONO, choose New to SBI, Open Savings Account, Without Branch Visit, Savings Account through Video KYC, enter PAN and Aadhaar details, enter Aadhaar OTP, provide other details, schedule and complete video call, then account is activated for debit transactions after bank verification.

title: SBI KYC Documents for Individuals
approvedBy: State Bank of India public website
content: SBI public KYC reference for individuals. Documents acceptable as proof of identity or address include passport, voter's identity card, driving licence, Aadhaar letter/card, NREGA card, and letter issued by the National Population Register containing name and address details. Any one document can be used toward proof of identity and proof of address, permanent or current. For minors below 10 years, submit ID proof of the person operating the account. Where a minor can operate independently, normal individual identification and address verification applies. For NRIs, passport and residence visa copies must be attested by foreign offices, notary public, Indian embassy, or officers of correspondent banks verifiable through an authorized forex handling branch. Small-account limits include aggregate credits in a financial year not exceeding INR 1 lakh, aggregate withdrawals and transfers in a month not exceeding INR 10,000, and balance at any time not exceeding INR 50,000.

title: SBI Savings Account Service Charge Notes
approvedBy: State Bank of India public website
content: SBI public service-charge page notes that penalty for non-maintenance of average monthly balance in savings bank accounts has been waived from 2020-03-11. The same page notes waiver of ATM/ADWM transaction decline charges for BSBD and KCC accounts from 2025-05-01 and lists revised service-charge notices for ATM transactions from 2025-02-01, advance-related service charges from 2025-06-01, penal charges policy from 2025-04-01, and foreign-exchange transaction service charges from 2025-05-01. Staff must verify the applicable schedule of charges for the exact account variant before final disclosure.

title: SBI Digital Savings Account Rules
approvedBy: State Bank of India public website
content: SBI public digital savings account notes: an eligible individual can open and operate the account in their own name, joint account or joint mandate is not permitted, and each eligible individual can open only one digital savings account. A Classic debit card is issued free of cost, ATM PIN must be generated through Green PIN, annual maintenance charges follow normal savings account guidelines, passbook is not provided and statement is sent by email, cheque-book charges are same as normal savings account, and a monthly electronic statement is available as per bank record. Customer must maintain minimum balance as defined for normal savings account, subject to current SBI charge waivers and extant guidelines. Eligibility includes resident Indian individual above 18 years, valid Aadhaar, valid PAN, active local mobile number in the customer's name, active email, biometric e-KYC at branch, and only one digital savings account per customer/device.

title: SBI Savings Plus Account
approvedBy: State Bank of India public website
content: SBI Savings Plus is a savings account linked to MODS where surplus funds above a threshold of INR 50,000 are automatically transferred to term deposits. Deposit period is 1 to 5 years. Facilities include ATM card, mobile banking, internet banking, SMS alerts, loan against MOD deposits, and account transfer through internet banking. Minimum threshold for transfer to MOD is INR 50,000. Minimum transfer amount to MOD is INR 15,000 and in multiples of INR 5,000 at one instance. Ten free cheque leaves per year are provided, with further leaves chargeable as per bank rules.

title: SBI Digital Safety Advisory
approvedBy: State Bank of India public website
content: SBI public safety advisory says State Bank of India never asks for user ID, password, PIN, or OTP through phone call, SMS, or email. Any such request may be an attempt to withdraw money from the account. Customers should never share credentials or OTP with anyone. For suspected unauthorized digital transactions or credential compromise, staff should advise immediate blocking/reporting through approved bank channels and follow the dispute or fraud SOP.
